chapter_seo_title: Damo's Return and Keke's Mother's Mysterious Box
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen meets Damo, who defeats three otherworldly semi-saints. On Dragon Island, Keke receives her mother's box; its multicolored light attacks the Seven Devil Diagram as an ancestral god descends.
